name: Canberra District

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon, Riesling and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A cool-climate region around Canberra, in the Southern New South Wales zone, with Murrumbateman, Yass and Bungendore among its key places. Lower, inland parts near Yass are warmer than the high ground near Bungendore. Shiraz is 32 percent of plantings, then Cabernet Sauvignon at 14 and Riesling at 12.
